metadata.title: Survey of India (SoI) 2024-2025 Revenue Sub-District (Tehsil) Reference Boundaries
metadata.source: Survey of India Administrative Boundary Database (ABDB)
metadata.note: These boundaries represent Revenue Sub-Districts (Tehsils), NOT LGD Development Blocks (Janpad Panchayats). They are provided for geospatial reference only and MUST NOT be used for Development Block indicators without verified coterminous evidence.
